hero.eyebrow: Full-Stack TypeScript Portfolio • Demo Crypto Exchange
hero.subtitle: A production-grade demo cryptocurrency exchange built from scratch in a Turborepo monorepo — featuring an in-memory B-Tree matching engine, automated local market makers, BFF & SSR React Query hydration, and multiplexed WebSocket streams.

monorepo.label: End-to-End Type Safety
monorepo.detail: Shared DTOs, Zod 4 schemas & CASL RBAC

pillars.title: 14 Architectural Pillars Built from First Principles
pillars.subtitle: Every layer of this exchange was custom-built to solve real financial-systems engineering challenges — from B-Tree order matching and local market makers to SSR React Query hydration.

realtimeOrders.title: Real-Time Order Lifecycle
realtimeOrders.desc: Instantaneous order placement, partial fills, and atomic cancellations with optimistic UI feedback and automatic React Query cache invalidation.

orderEngine.title: Powerful Matching Engine
orderEngine.desc: Price-time priority (FIFO) matching engine backed by sorted B-Trees and Big.js / 10^18 scaled integers to eliminate floating-point drift.

orderbookManager.title: Order Book Manager
orderbookManager.desc: Deterministic L2 depth aggregation with instant WebSocket snapshots, live bid/ask volume bars, directional tick indicators, and pause/resume controls.

marketMaker.title: Local Market Maker Bot
marketMaker.desc: Built-in autonomous liquidity provider that continuously quotes realistic bid-ask spreads and executes synthetic trades so the demo book is always alive.

ssrBff.title: SSR & BFF Architecture
ssrBff.desc: Server-side cookie forwarding, JWT expiry inspection in edge proxy, silent token rotation, and dehydrated TanStack Query state for instant first paint.

multilanguage.title: Bilingual & Bi-Directional
multilanguage.desc: Complete Persian (RTL, Vazir font, Jalali calendar) and English (LTR, Inter font, UTC) localization powered by next-intl with zero hydration mismatches.

advancedUx.title: Advanced Trading UX
advancedUx.desc: Drag-and-drop customizable workspace panels (@dnd-kit), TradingView charts, natural-language AI trading assistant, and responsive mobile order cards.

otpLogin.title: OTP Easy Login
otpLogin.desc: Frictionless two-step mobile verification flow with auto-advancing 6-digit OTP inputs, countdown resend timers, and automatic digit normalization.

qrLogin.title: QR Code Device Link
qrLogin.desc: Telegram/Discord-style cross-device authentication: scan a live SVG QR code, verify a confirmation code on the primary session, and approve or deny in real time.

fullstackJs.title: Full-Stack TypeScript
fullstackJs.desc: Next.js 16 & React 19 on the frontend paired with a high-throughput Fastify 5 API, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL double-entry ledger on the backend.

wsManager.title: WebSocket Connection Manager
wsManager.desc: Singleton external store integrated via useSyncExternalStore with reference-counted channel subscriptions, REST price seeding, idle auto-close, and exponential backoff.

monorepo.title: Modular Monorepo
monorepo.desc: Clean separation across apps/web, apps/api, and shared workspace packages (@repo/types, @repo/db, @repo/casl) with unified linting and builds.

genericQuery.title: Generic Query & Cache Layer
genericQuery.desc: Isomorphic queryOptions factories shared between server prefetch and client hooks, URL-synced table filters, keepPreviousData pagination, and smart active-order polling.

securityLedger.title: Double-Entry Wallet Ledger
securityLedger.desc: Auditable balance locking on order creation, fee deduction, self-trade prevention, and historical balance trend reconstruction.

architecture.title: End-to-End Data & Execution Pipeline
architecture.subtitle: How a single trade travels through the BFF layer, matching engine, double-entry ledger, and WebSocket broadcast pipeline.

client.title: 1. Client & URL State
client.desc: Shared queryOptions hydrate from SSR, while marketSocket subscribes to live symbols with reference counting.

bff.title: 2. Next.js SSR & BFF Proxy
bff.desc: Inspects JWT expiration before render, performs silent token refresh redirects, and prefetches API data on the server.

api.title: 3. Fastify 5 API & Auth Guard
api.desc: Validates DTOs, enforces role abilities, manages OTP & QR device-link state machines, and routes orders.

engine.title: 4. Matching Engine & Market Maker
engine.desc: Matches incoming orders against the B-Tree book, emits L2 snapshots & tickers, and runs local market-making bots.

db.title: 5. PostgreSQL & Drizzle Ledger
db.desc: Persists orders, trades, and immutable ledger entries (deposit, withdraw, lock, unlock, trade, fee).

authSpotlight.title: Multi-Modal Security: Classic, OTP & Live QR Handshake
authSpotlight.subtitle: Designed for both speed and security — complete with IP masking, User-Agent device parsing, and real-time cross-device session approval.

otp.title: One-Time Password (OTP) Easy Login
otp.step1: Persian/Arabic digits are normalized to ASCII on the fly
otp.step2: 6-digit OTP input with keyboard navigation & paste support
otp.step3: Automatic token rotation with HttpOnly cookies

qr.title: QR Code Cross-Device Login
qr.step1: Authenticated session generates a time-boxed SVG QR link
qr.step2: Second device opens the link and receives a verification code
qr.step3: Primary device inspects IP/OS and approves or denies live

cta.title: Ready to Test the Matching Engine Live?
cta.subtitle: Jump straight into the trading terminal, inspect the live order book, test the AI order assistant, or try the OTP and QR login flows.

footer.builtAs: Engineered as a Full-Stack TypeScript Portfolio Project.

aiSection.eyebrow: Neuro-Symbolic AI Workflow • Powered by JEV Agent
aiSection.title: Bilingual Trading Assistant with Zero-Hallucination Execution
aiSection.subtitle: Instead of letting a raw LLM guess numbers or execute unchecked trades, this exchange pairs the JEV decision agent (jev-1.13) with a deterministic slot extractor, Zod schema validation, interactive slot-filling, and a human-in-the-loop confirmation card.
aiSection.tryPrompts: Click a real user prompt to inspect the 4-stage JEV AI pipeline
aiSection.stage1Desc: After normalizing Persian/Arabic digits, JevClassifier queries the JEV Decision API across 3 constrained axes (intent, side, coin) and enforces minimum confidence thresholds.
aiSection.stage2Desc: The LLM never touches numbers. Regex & lexical rules extract exact amounts (USDT, BASE coin, or portfolio percentages like 'half' = 50%) and validate against IntentSchema.
aiSection.stage3Desc: Code determines which fields are missing (symbol, amount, or limit price), checks live wallet balances & WebSocket prices, and renders an explicit confirmation card.
